_provenance.how: Every company number, officer id, officer name, role and appointment date below was read off the PUBLIC register at find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk, which needs no key. The JSON envelope around them is the officerList resource as the Companies House Public Data API specification documents it, because no authenticated call has ever been made from this repository: the key exists only as a GitHub secret. So the VALUES are real and the SHAPE is documented-but-unverified. Two records are marked _constructed because the register gave no live example of them, and one has its appointed_on moved into the test window; each says so on its own line.
_provenance.test_today: 2026-07-30, which with the 42-day derived window makes the window 2026-06-18..2026-07-30
